title: A Inventory for the Weather
author: Coral Marchetti
blurb: Rosalind Coldharbour, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
